title: Offshore Holdings Pvt. Ltd. v. Bangalore Development Authority

content.caseIdentity: Offshore Holdings Pvt. Ltd. v. Bangalore Development Authority, (2011) 3 SCC 139
content.holding: Reaffirmed that incidental encroachment does not vitiate a State enactment where the primary subject matter falls within List II competence.
content.relevance: Modern Supreme Court reaffirmation of the doctrine.
